final_wiki.answer-Q-1282-A59:
Q-1282: What day of the week was 2025-09-17?

Answer: Wednesday

Reasoning: 2025-01-01 was a Wednesday. Days from Jan 1 to Sep 17: Jan(31)+Feb(28)+Mar(31)+Apr(30)+May(31)+Jun(30)+Jul(31)+Aug(31)+Sep 17 = 230 days. 230 mod 7 = 6. So 2025-09-17 is Wednesday + 6 days = Tuesday? Let me recount. Jan 1 = Wed (day 0). Sep 17 is day 259 of the year (31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+17=260, so day 260). Day 1 = Wed. Day 260: (260-1) mod 7 = 259 mod 7 = 59*7+6 = 6. Wed + 6 = Tuesday. Wait, let me be more careful. Jan 1, 2025 is Wednesday. Sep 17 is the 260th day of 2025. Offset from Jan 1 = 259 days. 259 / 7 = 37 weeks exactly (37*7=259). So same day of week as Jan 1 = Wednesday.
